editorial:
Imagine being a cop who has to pretend to be a scary gangster just to get inside a huge crime ring. That is exactly what happens here. You get to follow a detective who dives deep into the world of the Mokpo harbor to stop a massive drug deal. The vibe is a wild mix of high-stakes tension and laugh-out-loud comedy. It feels like a rollercoaster where you never know if the main character is going to get arrested by his own bosses or beaten up by the criminals he is trying to trick. It is a fun ride that keeps you guessing without being too serious.

The acting is great because the lead manages to be both funny and tough at the same time. The action scenes are snappy, and the plot moves fast so you never get bored. While some of the jokes might feel a bit dated, the energy makes up for it. You should definitely check this out if you love undercover stories.
endingExplained: In the end, the detective finally manages to expose the drug ring during the big deal. There is a huge fight where the undercover cop has to reveal his true identity to save his partners. He takes down the main boss in a satisfying showdown. After the dust settles, the criminals are hauled off to jail, and the detective gets recognized for his bravery, bringing a happy and exciting close to the story.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves undercover cop movies and crime comedies.
